title: Doorstep air
intro: A step outside, or even just to a window, can reset the room. Try one small idea.

prompts.text: Step through the nearest outside door and stand still for a few breaths.
Notice the temperature of the air on your face and hands.
Look for the tallest thing you can see and follow it to the top.
Find something green and spend a moment looking at its shape.
Notice the farthest sound you can hear, or the farthest thing you can see.
Take a slow lap of the doorstep, car park or courtyard.
Check which way the wind is blowing by watching leaves, flags or smoke.
Take your water bottle and refill it on the way back.
Look at the sky and describe its colour to yourself in three words.
Say hello to a neighbour, a passer-by or a friendly pet, if you meet one.

backAtDesk: Back inside. Take the fresh air with you.
